articles.title: Council Approves $1,200 for Carver Avenue Repairs
articles.deck: The vote came after 31 residents spoke at Sunday’s session.
body: Residents of Cedar Hollow said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Councilmember Xavier Yates asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $1,200.

Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.
Public works estimates the work will take about 31 weeks once it starts in April.
